record.context_brief: PTF sparsity for inner product mod 2
record.original_question: Does every polynomial threshold function representation of the inner product mod 2 function IP_{2n} : F2^{2n} -> {-1,1} require at least 3^n monomials?

evidence.quote: Statement: Is it true that any PTF representation of the inner product mod 2 function on 2 n bits, IP_{2n} : F2^{2n} -> {-1, 1}, requires at least 3^n monomials?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{F}_2 = \{0,1\}$ and define the inner product mod 2 function on $2n$ bits as
$$\mathrm{IP}_{2n}: \mathbb{F}_2^{2n} \to \{-1,+1\}, \qquad \mathrm{IP}_{2n}(x_1,\dots,x_n,y_1,\dots,y_n) = (-1)^{\sum_{i=1}^n x_i y_i}.$$
Identify $\mathbb{F}_2^{2n}$ with $\{-1,+1\}^{2n}$ via $b \mapsto (-1)^b$, so that Boolean functions on $\{-1,+1\}^{2n}$ admit a unique multilinear (Fourier) expansion $p(z) = \sum_{S \subseteq [2n]} \hat p(S) \prod_{i \in S} z_i$. A polynomial threshold function (PTF) representation of a Boolean function $f: \{-1,+1\}^{2n} \to \{-1,+1\}$ is a real multilinear polynomial $p$ such that $f(z) = \mathrm{sign}(p(z))$ for every $z \in \{-1,+1\}^{2n}$. The sparsity (or monomial count) of such a representation is the number of nonzero coefficients $\hat p(S)$.

Prove or disprove: every PTF representation of $\mathrm{IP}_{2n}$ uses at least $3^n$ monomials.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search surfaced related work on PTF sparsity, sign-rank lower bounds for inner-product mod 2 (Forster), weak-density bounds of order $2^n$, and recent sparsity lower bounds for probabilistic polynomials (ITCS 2025), but no source explicitly establishes (or refutes) the conjectured $3^n$ monomial lower bound for PTF representations of $\mathrm{IP}_{2n}$. The current status appears unresolved based on available search evidence.

status_evidence.title: Polynomial threshold functions and Boolean threshold circuits
status_evidence.snippet: Studies length (number of monomials) of PTFs and connections to inner product mod 2.
status_evidence.claim: Related work studies PTF sparsity but does not prove the 3^n bound for IP.

status_evidence.title: Sparsity Lower Bounds for Probabilistic Polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) sparsity lower bounds for probabilistic polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: Recent progress on sparsity lower bounds, without resolving the specific 3^n PTF question.

status_evidence.title: Extremal Properties of Polynomial Threshold Functions
status_evidence.snippet: PTF degree/sparsity tradeoffs for Boolean functions.
status_evidence.claim: Provides general PTF sparsity/degree theorems but does not settle the IP_{2n} 3^n conjecture.
